# CapTension

> Glyphs 4 plugin that gives native strokes the semi-square, semi-round hybrid caps Glyphs cannot make natively — plus FontLab-style adjustable cap tension: `0` pointed, `55.23` round, `55.23–100` semi-square/semi-round, `100` square.

CapTension is a free, open-source Glyphs 4 palette plugin for type designers. It replaces the three-way choice between butt, round, and square line caps with a continuous parameter, and it can apply different values to the two ends of the same path.

## Facts

- Platform: macOS, Glyphs 4
- Plugin bundle: `CapTension.glyphsPalette`
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/pentalogos/CapTension
- UI languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
- Scope: selected endpoints/paths in Edit View, or selected glyphs in Font View
- Does not cross masters or layers implicitly

## Features

- Semi-square / semi-round hybrid caps between round and square, not only the three native caps
- Continuous `0–100` cap shape: pointed, round, square, and in-between
- Per-endpoint values on the same path
- Real, locked, filled cap paths that remain editable in Glyphs
- Fixed cap node count, suitable for variable-font interpolation
- Selection-scoped apply and clear
- Python scripting API (`api.py`) for glyph, master, layer, or font batches
- Clipboard-ready batch API instructions from the palette

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pentalogos/CapTension.git
cp -R CapTension/plugins/CapTension.glyphsPalette \
  ~/Library/Application\ Support/Glyphs\ 4/Plugins/
```

Restart Glyphs 4. The CapTension palette appears in the sidebar.

## Usage

1. Open a glyph in Edit View, or select glyphs in Font View.
2. Select endpoints or open paths in Edit View.
3. Drag the slider or enter a value.
4. Click Apply to Selection.
5. Click Clear to remove cap paths and restore native square caps.

## Scripting API

The plugin exposes `api.py` for Glyphs Macro Panel and scripts:

```python
api.apply_layer(layer, shape=55.23, ends=None)
api.clear_layer(layer, ends=None)
api.apply_glyph(glyph, shape=55.23, masters=None, ends=None)
api.clear_glyph(glyph, masters=None, ends=None)
api.apply_font(font, shape=55.23, glyphs=None, masters=None, ends=None)
api.clear_font(font, glyphs=None, masters=None, ends=None)
api.set_value(value, font=None)
api.get_value(font=None)
```

## Utilities

- `scripts/copy_outlines_to_masters.py`: copy the current or selected glyphs to selected masters, with per-master stroke and cap-tension attributes, master groups, select-all, save/load presets, and remembered selections.
- `scripts/clear_cap_tension.py`: remove CapTension cap paths and state for the current or selected glyphs across all masters.

## Supported paths

Only open paths with equal `strokeWidth` and `strokeHeight`, a centered stroke, and a solid stroke color are processed. Closed paths and gradient strokes are skipped.
